infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: StyleFleet needs access to your contacts to import clients into your salon roster.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: StyleFleet needs access to your camera to capture salon photos and scan service rate cards.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: StyleFleet needs access to your photo library to select salon logos and upload service menus.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: StyleFleet uses your location to automatically determine your salon address and city.
